mapper.sql: select brt.original_execution_id as "originalExecutionId", be.batch_id as "batchId", be.execution_status as "executionStatus", brt.failed_item_key as "failedItemKey", brt.failure_reason as "failureReason", ber.started_at as "startedAt", ber.ended_at as "endedAt" from batch_retry_targets brt join batch_executions be on be.execution_id = brt.original_execution_id left join batch_execution_results ber on ber.execution_id = be.execution_id

sql.where:
be.execution_status = 'FAILED'
and brt.original_execution_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.originalExecutionId}, '%')
and brt.failed_item_key ilike concat('%', #{criteria.failedItemKey}, '%')

mapper.select: order by ber.ended_at desc nulls last, brt.original_execution_id, brt.failed_item_key nulls first limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from batch_retry_targets brt join batch_executions be on be.execution_id = brt.original_execution_id left join batch_execution_results ber on ber.execution_id = be.execution_id
mapper.insert: insert into batch_executions (execution_id, batch_id, process_type, reason, operator_user_id, execution_status, original_execution_id, request_id) values (#{retryExecutionId}, #{batchId}, #{processType}, #{reason}, #{operatorUserId}, 'RUNNING', #{originalExecutionId}, #{requestId})

insert into batch_retry_results (retry_execution_id, original_execution_id, failed_item_key, retry_reason, request_id, created_by) values (#{retryExecutionId}, #{originalExecutionId}, #{failedItemKey}, #{retryReason}, #{requestId}, (select operator_user_id from batch_executions where execution_id = #{retryExecutionId}))
mapper.select: select retry_execution_id as "retryExecutionId", original_execution_id as "originalExecutionId", failed_item_key as "failedItemKey", retry_reason as "retryReason", request_id as "requestId", created_at as "createdAt", created_by as "createdBy" from batch_retry_results where retry_execution_id = #{retryExecutionId}
